description: Deterministic labeled fixture set for CONTRADICTION RESOLUTION accuracy. Each case supplies two (or more) claims with sources and expects one classification label. Labels: 'contradiction' means a genuine UNRESOLVED conflict (same measure: unit+scope+period+metric, materially different values); 'not_contradiction' means the engine must NOT flag it at all; 'resolved_explained' means it is flagged as a spread but resolution sets resolved=true with an explanation (period/scope/metric difference demonstrably accounts for the values). At most ONE primary claim pair per case is scored (the first two claims); extra claims are context. Detection and resolution are scored as separate deterministic metrics so the gate can tell a false positive from a false 'resolved'.

cases.rationale: Same unit (GW), same scope (global), same period (2023), same metric (installed solar capacity): materially different values are a real cross-source conflict that must stay unresolved.

claims.claim: Global installed solar capacity reached 1,200 GW in 2023
Global installed solar capacity reached 1,600 GW in 2023

cases.rationale: Same unit (%), same scope (global), same period (last year), same metric (market growth): 25% vs 11% is a genuine disagreement.

claims.claim: The market grew by 25% globally last year
The market grew by 11% globally last year

cases.rationale: A primary journal and a secondary blog report the same measure (mortality reduction, %) for the same trial and period with materially different values. Primary/secondary weighting is visible on the sources, but the discrepancy is NOT explained by scope/period/metric, so it must not be silently marked resolved.

claims.claim: The trial reported a mortality reduction of 15% versus placebo
The trial reported a mortality reduction of 40% versus placebo

cases.rationale: Same measure (global solar capacity, GW) reported for different years: the period difference explains the values. A period explanation must be recorded.

claims.claim: Global installed solar capacity reached 1,200 GW in 2023
Global installed solar capacity reached 1,600 GW in 2024

cases.rationale: Same measure (installed generation capacity, GW) for different years with a materially different value. Period explains the spread.

claims.claim: Bangladesh's installed power generation capacity was 5 GW in 2009
Bangladesh's installed power generation capacity reached 26.5 GW by 2024

cases.rationale: Same metric (carbon emissions change, %), same period, but different scope: global vs United States. Different populations, not a disagreement; a scope explanation must be recorded.

claims.claim: Carbon emissions fell 30% globally across the power sector in 2022
Carbon emissions fell 5% in the United States across the power sector in 2022

cases.rationale: Two explicitly different populations (urban vs rural adults) with different values are not the same measure. The engine records this as a scope spread (resolved=true, never counted as an unresolved conflict) and must NOT leave it as a genuine contradiction. The scope difference is the visible explanation.

claims.claim: The literacy rate among urban adults was 82% in 2020
The literacy rate among rural adults was 61% in 2020

cases.rationale: Regression for commit 18d4da8: a Rooppur cost claim and a '38 countries' declaration share a year but are different measures. They must never be paired, even as a period conflict.

claims.claim: The Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant has an estimated construction cost of 12.65 billion US dollars as of June 2024
The Declaration to Triple Nuclear Energy by 2050 has been endorsed by 38 countries

cases.rationale: Two unrelated measures that happen to share a number (12%) and a year. Shared numbers alone are not evidence of a conflict.

claims.claim: Coal's share of electricity generation fell to 12% in 2021
The central bank raised its policy rate by 12% in 2021 to curb inflation

cases.rationale: A percentage and a GW capacity are different units/metrics; their magnitude difference is a category error, not a disagreement.

claims.claim: Module efficiency improved by 22% in the latest generation
New plants added 22 GW of capacity in the latest generation

cases.rationale: Same subject, directly opposite assertions. Same scope and period: this is the strongest genuine conflict and must stay unresolved.

claims.claim: The new model outperforms the baseline on all benchmarks
The new model does not outperform the baseline on all benchmarks

cases.rationale: Regression: a period difference cannot explain opposite directions. 'fell 12% in 2020' vs 'rose 12% in 2023' is a polarity conflict about the same measure; reporting different years must NOT auto-resolve it as a period artifact.

claims.claim: Coal capacity fell 12% in 2020 across the region
Coal capacity rose 12% in 2023 across the region

cases.rationale: Regression: the claims agree on the measure (26.5 GW in 2024); one merely mentions an extra historical year (5 GW in 2009) as context. The values are not a cross-source disagreement, and the engine must not manufacture a 'temporal' conflict (then 'resolve' it) from an incidental year token.

claims.claim: Bangladesh capacity reached 26.5 GW in 2024, up from 5 GW in 2009
Bangladesh capacity was 26.5 GW in 2024
